# Raster inputs and generated rasters

## Source/prepared inputs required before the pipeline
- `reference_grid_25m.tif`
- `lithology_25m.tif`
- `dist_fault_25m.tif`
- `dist_silicified_25m.tif`
- `dist_brecciated_25m.tif`

All rasters are expected to be aligned to the common 25 × 25 m grid in WGS 84 / UTM Zone 35N (EPSG:32635), as described in the manuscript.

## Generated by the pipeline
- `Pb_OK.tif`, `Zn_OK.tif`, `Cu_OK.tif`
- kriging-variance rasters
- final RF continuous probability, ensemble SD, and P90 prospectivity rasters

Generated rasters are reproducible pipeline outputs. Their inclusion in the public repository is determined by the repository release policy described in the root README and `.gitignore`.
